name: cybertrace-workspace
description: CyberTrace — Digital Forensic Case & Incident Management Root Workspace

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env') && fs.existsSync('backend/.env.example')) fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example', 'backend/.env'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env') && fs.existsSync('backend/.env.example')) fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example', '.env');" && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
